blocking_findings.summary: PRD acceptance requires BOSS dry-run navigation + fill end-to-end, but backend/app/platforms/boss/adapter.py explicitly defers full Playwright navigation/fill/final-submit logic to a follow-up. Current behavior proves the safety contracts with a fake adapter but cannot run the real platform pilot.

non_blocking_risks.summary: Frontend guided-submit panel can prepare and submit only after its local action state is populated from submit/abort responses; after a successful prepare it points the user to the sibling approval panel rather than hydrating the new action directly. This is acceptable for the safety-contract phase but should be polished with a detail endpoint or action-list refresh before real pilot UX.

blocking_findings.summary: Real BOSS Web adapter still returns safe unknown outcomes and does not perform Playwright navigation/fill/classification. This intentionally avoids false submitted results, but it means the PRD acceptance item 'Dry-run navigation + fill works end-to-end' is not yet satisfied for the real platform.

resolved_findings.summary: Frontend approval-to-submit loop was incomplete; fixed by refreshing platform_submit actions after prepare and approval changes.
RealBossAdapter previously synthesized submitted results; fixed to return unknown until real browser logic exists.

summary: RealBossAdapter now implements real Playwright navigation, page classification, fill, and stop-before-submit (prepare) plus exactly-one-click final submit with conservative result classification (submit). All seven platform failure categories are covered by deterministic fake-Playwright tests. No credentials/cookies/tokens/raw HTML/session paths are persisted. Manual pilot runbook exists at docs/manual-boss-pilot.md. The PRD acceptance item 'Dry-run navigation + fill works end-to-end and stops before submit' is satisfied at the unit-test level; real-browser validation is deferred to the manual pilot runbook (no Playwright install in CI).

fixes_applied.summary: Added boss_adapter_enabled + boss_session_profile_dir to Settings; registry now uses get_settings() instead of os.environ.get.
Created app/platforms/boss/runtime.py — BossBrowserRuntime + BossPage wrapper with bounded timeouts (30s nav / 15s action) and deterministic cleanup.
Created app/platforms/boss/selectors.py — centralized selector registry using stable semantic locators (role/label/placeholder).
Created app/platforms/boss/classifiers.py — conservative classify_page (7 outcomes) + classify_submit_result (submitted/duplicate/platform_failure/unknown).
Created app/platforms/boss/sanitizer.py — sanitize_url (sha256 hash), sanitize_title (truncate + strip secrets), sanitize_diagnostic (strip tokens/profile paths).
Rewrote RealBossAdapter.prepare_submission: profile-dir guard → open page → classify → fill message → verify submit visible (never click) → sanitized snapshot.

Rewrote RealBossAdapter.submit_prepared: profile-dir guard → open page → classify → re-apply approved message → click final submit exactly once → classify result (submitted only on observed success marker).
Added [boss] optional dependency group (playwright>=1.40) to pyproject.toml; not in main dependencies.
Created docs/manual-boss-pilot.md manual pilot runbook covering profile creation, env flags, non-critical record selection, stop-before-submit verification, failure capture, and rollback.

Added test_boss_sanitizer.py (14 tests), test_boss_classifiers.py (13 tests), test_boss_real_adapter.py (10 tests) using fake Playwright objects covering all failure categories, stop-before-submit, exactly-one-click, and no-secrets-in-results assertions.

non_blocking_risks.summary: No real Playwright browser in CI; real-browser validation is deferred to the manual pilot runbook (docs/manual-boss-pilot.md). This is the accepted strategy from real-boss-adapter-plan.md Phase 1 acceptance.
BOSS selectors may drift over time; selector_drift hard-stop + runbook rollback covers this, but real-platform selector validation is a manual step.
Frontend guided-submit panel hydration from the earlier fix remains acceptable; no further UX changes were needed for this adapter implementation.

summary: CDP 模式手动实测完成。系统性地验证了 BOSS 直聘的反自动化检测机制（5 种方式全部失败，唯一可行路径为 CDP+手动导航）。据此修改 runtime.py：CDP 模式永不调用 page.goto，复用用户已打开的页面。3 个 CDP 测试覆盖连接、不关 context、复用已有页面。实测报告记录在 docs/boss-anti-automation-findings.md。全量 522 测试通过，无回归。所有安全不变量保留。

fixes_applied.summary: config.py 新增 boss_cdp_endpoint 进程配置字段（env BOSS_CDP_ENDPOINT）。
runtime.py _OpenContext.__aenter__ 增加 CDP 分支：connect_over_cdp → contexts[0].pages[0]，永不调用 page.goto。
runtime.py _close_cdp：只断开 CDP 客户端连接（browser.close），不关闭用户的 Chrome context/page。
adapter.py prepare_submission / submit_prepared 读取 boss_cdp_endpoint 并传入 BossBrowserRuntime。
test_boss_real_adapter.py 新增 FakeCdpBrowser + 3 个 CDP 测试：连接不关 context、submit 点击不关 context、复用已有页面不新建。
docs/manual-boss-pilot.md 更新：步骤 1 改为 CDP + 手动导航方式，记录 BOSS 反自动化检测 4 点机制，安全不变量新增 CDP 永不 goto + endpoint 不走请求/队列/DB。
docs/boss-anti-automation-findings.md：完整的 BOSS 反自动化检测实测报告，含 7 个实验场景、检测机制总结、可行方案、后续优化方向。

non_blocking_risks.summary: BOSS 会检测 CDP Runtime.evaluate 调用并在多次调用后关闭页面。当前适配器的 classify/fill/click 底层依赖 evaluate，在实际投递中可能触发页面关闭。缓解：页面关闭时返回 unknown 硬停止，用户手动重新打开页面。后续可探索 CDP DOM API 替代 evaluate。
BOSS selectors may drift over time; selector_drift hard-stop + runbook rollback covers this, but real-platform selector validation is a manual step.
CDP 模式不支持自动导航（不能 goto），每次操作前用户需手动在 Chrome 中导航到目标页面。这是 BOSS 反自动化检测下的固有约束。
